policy_notes: ENRICH-NOT-CUT: the scope-cut list (docs/feature-escape-pod-intro.md) is a TRUE-TECHNICAL-WALL safety net ONLY, never a target, ALWAYS surfaced to the user before any cut; the spine + pod + descent + tutorial are NOT cuttable. Hero geometry/FX -> the procedural-modeler agent, iterated to a quality BAR (5-8 rounds new hero elements). Real first-person in-game-view visual gate (not an isolated rig). Anti-punt. Behind FEATURES.escapePodIntro (default off until shipped). No SAVE_VERSION bump unless unavoidable (D81; the introComplete marker is additive, legacy=true). New game -> the intro; old spawn -> dev-mode only. Key early-build decisions to lock in Phase 0: R1 save-marker, R2 world-loading-during-descent, R3 handoff seam, R4 state-machine contract + KCC-on-ship-floor, R5 scrap_machete-as-pry-tool (D261, additive), R6 entry point, R7 parachute-gag fallback, R10 accessibility/photosensitivity. See the feature doc's 'Pre-build review'.
